topic: Comparing routines and clarifying a community plan

vocabulary.meaning_en: make something clear or easier to understand

near_synonyms.distinction: give information; clarify makes something less confusing or more precise

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: make something clear or easier to understand
senses_by_pos.example: Could you clarify the final step?

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: an explanation that makes something clear
senses_by_pos.example: Could you provide some clarification on the schedule?

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: the quality of being clear and easy to understand

vocabulary.meaning_en: examine two or more things to identify similarities or differences
collocations: a comparison between A and B

near_synonyms.distinction: focuses on differences; compare can examine similarities and differences

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: examine two or more things to identify similarities or differences
senses_by_pos.example: Compare the two routines before choosing one.

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: describe something as similar to something else
senses_by_pos.example: She compared the city to a maze.

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: an examination of similarities and differences
senses_by_pos.example: The comparison revealed an important difference.

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: based on comparison, or true in relation to something else
senses_by_pos.example: We discussed the comparative advantages of both plans.

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: a grammatical form such as better or smaller used when comparing
senses_by_pos.example: Better is the comparative of good.
The new routine is comparatively flexible.

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: similar enough in size or quality for a useful comparison
senses_by_pos.example: The two courses are comparable in length.
The two rooms are comparably priced.

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: the extent to which things can usefully be compared
senses_by_pos.example: Different methods reduce the comparability of the results.

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: so outstanding that nothing else matches it
senses_by_pos.example: The garden offers an incomparable view.

senses_by_pos.meaning_en: to a degree that is far beyond another
senses_by_pos.example: The new route is incomparably safer.

vocabulary.usage_note: Both with and to can introduce a comparison. Compare X to Y also commonly means liken X to Y; do not mark to wrong automatically.

prestudy_steps: Review the clarify and compare family boxes.
Say each lemma and member aloud with en-GB TTS.
Return numbered answers and uncertainty notes in chat.

self_checks.prompt: In “Could you clarify the final step?”, clarify means: A make it shorter; B make it clearer; C make it stricter; D make it earlier.
Without looking at the cards, translate: 請你澄清最後一個步驟。
Complete “Compare the morning routine ___ the evening routine.” Then explain whether another preposition is possible.
Complete: I asked for a ______ because the instructions were unclear.
Write two sentences: compare two study routines, then ask for clarification about one unclear detail.
